label: Burrata
note: A mozzarella shell filled with stracciatella and cream

about.text: Burrata is an Italian fresh cheese from Apulia: a shell of pasta filata mozzarella filled with stracciatella and cream.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.label: fill a mozzarella pouch
how.text: The stretched curd is formed into a pouch and filled with stracciatella, the shredded curd mixed with cream, then closed.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The stretched curd is shredded for the filling.
The shredded curd is mixed with cream into stracciatella.
The stretched curd is formed into a pouch.

steps.name: fill and close
steps.note: The pouch is filled with stracciatella and closed.
